heroHeadline: EU Restores Full Trade Ties with Syria; Rubio Confirms Comprehensive Sanctions Relief
heroSubtitle: The EU Council reinstated the full EU-Syria Cooperation Agreement (May 11) — suspended since 2011 — and pledged €280 million, while US Secretary of State Rubio met Syrian FM al-Shaibani in Antalya to confirm comprehensive sanctions relief (May 15). UN warns Syria's 2026 humanitarian appeal is only 16% funded as WFP halves food aid to 650,000 people. Israel conducted ground raids into Quneitra villages (May 16), marking continued military pressure on southern Syria. Syria's transitional government reported ~120,000 voluntary refugee returns from Lebanon in the first four months of 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, UN agencies, and institutional analyses. Historical events drawn from established academic consensus.
